name: Echo Tokyo: An Intro
source:
Echo Tokyo is the last bastion of humanity. A nuclear fog has made street level uninhabitable.

Now hundreds of years later Echo Tokyo lives on, by building bridges and platforms between the skyscrapers to create a new city in the sky. This cyber punk city somehow manages to function without government or law, where the companies rule and order is what people make it for themselves

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/345700/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
回聲東京是人類最後的堡壘。核霧讓地面街道變得無法居住。

數百年後，回聲東京依然存在。人們在摩天大樓之間搭建橋樑和平臺，創造出一座漂浮於天空的新城市。這座電馭龐克城市不知為何在沒有政府和法律的情況下維持著運轉：企業掌握統治權，而秩序則由人們自行建立。

[來自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/345700/]Steam[/url]]
